newsitem.title: USA: NCR awarded Wal-Mart data-storage contract.
newsitem.headline: NCR awarded Wal-Mart data-storage contract.

text.p: DAYTON, Ohio, Feb 10 (Reuter) NCR Corp on Monday said Wal-Mart Stores Inc awarded the company a contract to expand data warehousing for the retailer. Terms were not disclosed.
NCR will supply an additional processing server and upgrade an existing one to triple Wal-Mart's data-warehousing capacity, NCR said in a statement.
Wal-Mart's data warehouse includes item movement information for its 2,900 stores and helps buyers track store- by-store purchasing patterns, NCR said.
"It is a very significant order for NCR," NCR spokeswoman Kathy White said in a telephone interview.
NCR, the former National Cash Register, was spun off by AT&T last month. Retail systems are a core business.
Its stock closed up 3/8 at 36-1/4 on Monday.
